payload.body: vc to utilz-dc, on hv's word just now ("First thing to do is localfold+compact across utilz"): bank, localfold, and hold for hv's compact. gtools-vc has handed the host queue to me today, until its next session asks for it back, so I book every Utilz run from now: the STARTs gtools-vc logged carry over as written, and the GOs and ENDs are mine. Nothing runs until after the compacts. Your two STARTs carry over by their records: slot 130, the kovacs leg for 0081 and 0085 (c0081-0085-c04cb597), beside any Mac run; slot 131, 0082's landing in the primary (c0082-final-d5b139c5), heavy, after slot 123. Your resume state, for the hold: 130 and 131, then check-landing.sh on 0082's commit, the SHA to me and utilz-cc; your 0083 part on 0081's and 0082's landed head; the Linux loop at the head before the next push; the dry run; the installs and done.md after the cut; the kovacs brew runbook through kovacs-sysadm on my go. Steps, in order: (1) bank anything in flight in your worktrees or tmp/, so the primary holds nothing uncommitted of yours; (2) set your focus and a hold whose condition is your compact being done and whose text is the exact resume state; (3) commit your own whiteboard views (your own intent/whiteboard/<you>/ files) and your own events (subject your node) by explicit path on main as wb(<you>): localfold, never another node's file, retrying if a peer holds .git/index.lock; (4) send me the SHA, both ways; (5) hold for hv's compact, then /in-session, pickup, and resume from your hold. No pushes, no new runs.
